y-m-18-03.title: Isixazululo segrafu yebhande likaHaeun: yini ebukeka ingajwayelekile?
y-m-18-03.goal: Kusixazululo sokubala amaphesenti, thola umugqa oyiphutha nethiphu lokuthi 'uma isamba singeyona u-100%, kuphutha,' bese wenza izinombolo zocwaningo ezinika igrafu yebhande efanayo.
y-m-18-03.material: U-Haeun, umfundi webanga lesi-6, wenze ukuthi abafundi abangu-40 eklasini yakhe ngamunye akhethe 'isizini ayithandayo.' Imiphumela yinhlobo yentwasahlobo abafundi abangu-12, ihlobo abafundi abangu-14, ikwindla abafundi abangu-8, nobusika abafundi abangu-6. U-Haeun uxazulule njengaphansi ukukukhombisa kugrafu yebhande. Lonke ibhande legrafu yebhande lingu-100%.
y-m-18-03.thinking.1: Ukuhlola ngokwakho usebenzisa umbandela wokuthi okuphelele kungu-100%
y-m-18-03.thinking.2: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi osayizi abaningana bocwaningo bangenza igrafu yebhande efanayo
y-m-18-03.prereq.1: Incazelo yokuthi lonke ibhande legrafu yebhande lingu-100%
y-m-18-03.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa owodwa ophutha kusixazululo sikaHaeun. (Izinombolo zemigqa ziqala ku-1.)
y-m-18-03.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola umugqa ngamunye ngokuguqula iphesenti libuyele enanini labantu (isb. u-30% wabafundi abangu-40 mangaki).
y-m-18-03.s.s1.hint.1: Bheka ukuthi umphumela womugqa wokugcina ufanela umbandela wegrafu yebhande yini.
y-m-18-03.s.s1.line.5: Ukwengeza wonke amaphesenti kunika 30+35+2+15=82%. Nakuba kunjalo, ungagcwalisa futhi udwebe ibhande kuphela kuze kufike ku-82%.
y-m-18-03.s.s1.explain: Emugqeni 4, u-0.2 ungu-20%, kodwa wabhalwa njengo-2%. Futhi emugqeni 6, uphawu lokuthi isamba singu-82% hhayi u-100% lwabonwa kodwa igrafu yadwetshwa noma kunjalo. Okuphelele kwegrafu yebhande ngu-100%, ngakho uma amaphesenti engahlanganiseki abe ngu-100, omunye umugqa awulungile.
y-m-18-03.s.s2.prompt: Igrafu yebhande yenhlolovo yeklasi elinye ithi ‘i-dodgeball 40%, ibhola lezinyawo 30%, ukugxuma intambo 20%, okunye 10%.’ Yenza izinguqulo ezi-2 ezihlukene zenani labantu abahlolwe N (abafundi) nenani kuzinto ngayinye ezingaphuma kule grafu yebhande. (N iyinombolo yemvelo engu-60 noma ngaphansi.)
y-m-18-03.s.s2.hint.0: Okunye ngu-10%, ngakho qala ngokubhala ukuthi abafundi bangaki entweni ngayinye uma okuphelele kungabafundi abangu-10.
y-m-18-03.s.s2.hint.1: Ushintsha inani eliphelele labantu, hlola ukuthi into ngayinye iphuma njengenombolo yemvelo yabafundi yini.
y-m-18-03.s.s2.hint.2: Hlola ukuthi izinombolo zabantu ozenzile zihambisana nenani eliphelele labafundi nokuthi amaphesenti awashintshanga yini.
y-m-18-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Inani eliphelele labafundi liyinombolo yemvelo kusukela ku-1 kuya ku-60.
y-m-18-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Inani eliphelele labafundi kumele libe yinombolo yemvelo engu-60 noma ngaphansi.
y-m-18-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Inani ngalinye labantu liyinombolo yemvelo engu-0 noma ngaphezulu.
y-m-18-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Inani ngalinye labantu kumele libe yinombolo yemvelo engu-0 noma ngaphezulu.
y-m-18-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Izinombolo zabantu kuzo zonke izinto ziyahlangana zibe yinani eliphelele labafundi.
y-m-18-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Isamba sezinombolo zabantu ezintweni sihlukile enanini eliphelele labafundi.
y-m-18-03.s.s2.ok.c4: I-dodgeball 40%, ibhola lezinyawo 30%, nokugxuma intambo 20% kulungile.
y-m-18-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Amaphesenti e-dodgeball, ibhola lezinyawo, nokugxuma intambo awangu-40%, 30%, no-20%.
y-m-18-03.s.s2.explain: Uma N=10, kungabafundi abangu-4, 3, 2, 1, futhi uma N=20, kungabafundi abangu-8, 6, 4, 2. Kuzo zombili izimo amaphesenti kugrafu yebhande ayafana. 40%, 30%, 20%, no-10% konke kungaboniswa njengezinombolo zemvelo zabantu uma N iyi-multiple ka-10.
y-m-18-03.s.s3.prompt: Ukuze uHaeun angenzi iphutha elifanayo futhi, mtshele indlela eyodwa yokuthola yena ukuthi yini engalungile ngaphambi kokudweba igrafu yebhande.
y-m-18-03.s.s3.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi igrafu yebhande lonke liyiliphi iphesenti, nokuthi ungaqhathanisa kanjani amanani abaliwe nalo.
y-m-18-03.s.s3.hint.1: Funda umugqa wokugcina wesixazululo sikaHaeun bese ucabanga ukuthi yini ebufanele ukuyiqaphela kuleso sigaba.
y-m-18-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe kucacile ‘ukuthi yini ehlolwayo’ (isib. ukuthi isamba singu-100% yini)?
y-m-18-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ubhale nokuthi yini okufanele yenziwe uma umphumela wokuhlola ungeyona u-100?
y-m-18-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe iyindlela ethile uHaeun angayilandela ngokushesha?
y-m-18-03.s.s3.model.0: Engeza wonke amaphesenti bese uhlola ukuthi enza u-100% yini. Uma kungeyona u-100, njengo-82%, kukhona okungalungile endaweni ethile, ngakho bheka futhi imigqa oyibalile.
y-m-18-03.s.s3.model.1: Uma uhlola kokubili ukuthi izinombolo zabantu zenkathi ngayinye ziyahlangana zibe ngu-40 nokuthi amaphesenti ahlangana abe ngu-100%, kulula ukuthola umugqa ongalungile.

y-m-18-05.title: Uma sihlanganisa amaklasi amabili, isilinganiso sonke siyini?
y-m-18-05.goal: Qonda ukuthi isilinganiso sonke asikwazi ukumiswa ngezilinganiso zamaqembu amabili kuphela, sho ukuthi yiluphi olunye ulwazi oludingekayo, bese wenza wena izinombolo zabafundi ezihambisana nemibandela.
y-m-18-05.material: IKlasi 1 neKlasi 2 eBangeni 6 benze ukuhlolwa kwezibalo okufanayo. Wonke amaphuzu asukela ku-0 kuya ku-100. Isilinganiso seKlasi 1 singamaphuzu angu-70 futhi isilinganiso seKlasi 2 singu-80. UHajun uthe, “Isilinganiso sabo bonke abafundi emaklasini amabili ahlanganisiwe ngu-(70+80)÷2=75 amaphuzu.” Izinombolo zabafundi emaklasini amabili azikatshelwa.

y-m-18-05.thinking.2: Ukwenza inhlanganisela yezinombolo zabantu ehambisana nemibandela
y-m-18-05.s.s1.prompt: Ukuze u-75 amaphuzu kaHajun alungile ngqo, yini kulokhu okulandelayo okufanele yaziwe?
y-m-18-05.s.s1.hint.0: Zwakalisa ukuthi isilinganiso sonke sisondele ku-75 amaphuzu yini uma iKlasi 1 inomfundi o-1 neKlasi 2 inabafundi abangu-99.
y-m-18-05.s.s1.hint.1: Kukho konke ukukhetha, hlola ngamunye ukuthi isilinganiso sonke sishukunyiselwa kuphi uma kuyiqiniso.
y-m-18-05.s.s1.r.a: Isilinganiso sonke sisondela esilinganisweni sohlangothi olunabafundi abaningi. Bese ucabanga ukuthi sizoba ngu-75 amaphuzu yini.
y-m-18-05.s.s1.r.b: Lokhu kucabange ukuthi usayizi weqembu uthinta isilinganiso. Uma osayizi belingana, izilinganiso ezimbili zibalwa ngokulinganayo.
y-m-18-05.s.s1.o.c: Amaklasi womabili anomfundi othole amaphuzu angu-100.
y-m-18-05.s.s1.r.c: Ngisho noma amaphuzu aphezulu efana, isilinganiso sonke asibi maphakathi kwezilinganiso ezimbili.
y-m-18-05.s.s1.o.d: Bonke abafundi beKlasi 2 bathole amaphuzu angu-80.
y-m-18-05.s.s1.r.d: Ngisho noma wonke amaphuzu eKlasi 2 efana, uma izinombolo zabafundi emaklasini amabili zihlukile, isilinganiso sonke siyahluka.
y-m-18-05.s.s1.explain: Kuphela uma amaklasi amabili enenani elifanayo labafundi isilinganiso sonke singu-75 amaphuzu, maphakathi ngqo nezilinganiso ezimbili. Uma izinombolo zabafundi zihlukile, isilinganiso sonke siya ekhlasini elinabafundi abaningi.
y-m-18-05.s.s2.prompt: Manje uyazi ukuthi iKlasi 1 inabafundi abangu-20 neKlasi 2 inabafundi abangu-30. Isilinganiso sonke siqhathaniswa kanjani no-75 amaphuzu?
y-m-18-05.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi yiliphi iklasi labafundi abangu-20 noma abangu-30 elinomthelela omkhulu kokuphelele ngamaphuzu alo.
y-m-18-05.s.s2.hint.1: Dweba njengomugqa wezinombolo lapho phakathi kuka-70 no-80 amaphuzu isilinganiso sonke sasiseduze khona.
y-m-18-05.s.s2.r.a: Uxubile izilinganiso zamaklasi amabili anezinombolo zabafundi ezihlukile ngamanani alinganayo.
y-m-18-05.s.s2.r.b: Iklasi elinabafundi abaningi yilona elinamaphuzu aphezulu, kodwa ucabange ngokuthi isilinganiso sonke siyehla.
y-m-18-05.s.s2.o.c: Awukwazi ukusho ukuthi siphezulu noma siphansi kuno-75 amaphuzu.
y-m-18-05.s.s2.r.c: Uyazi izinombolo zabafundi nezilinganiso zamaklasi womabili, ngakho ungamisa isiqondiso.
y-m-18-05.s.s2.r.d: Wahlulele ukuthi isilinganiso sonke siya esilinganisweni esingu-80 samaphuzu seKlasi 2, elinabafundi abaningi.
y-m-18-05.s.s2.explain: IKlasi 2 inabafundi abaningi futhi isilinganiso seKlasi 2 siphezulu, ngakho isilinganiso sonke siphezulu kuno-75 amaphuzu. Empeleni, (70×20+80×30)÷50=76 amaphuzu.
y-m-18-05.s.s3.prompt: Isilinganiso seKlasi 1 esingu-70 amaphuzu nesilinganiso seKlasi 2 esingu-80 amaphuzu sihlala sifana. Yenza izinguqulo ezi-2 ezihlukene zezinombolo zabafundi ukuze isilinganiso sonke sihlanganisiwe samaklasi amabili sibe ngu-78 amaphuzu ngqo. (IKlasi 1 inabafundi abangu-m, iKlasi 2 inabafundi abangu-n, iklasi ngalinye linabangu-5 noma ngaphezulu, futhi amaklasi amabili ndawonye anabangu-50 noma ngaphansi.)

y-m-18-05.s.s3.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi u-78 useqhelelene kangakanani no-70 nokuthi useqhelelene kangakanani no-80, phakathi kuka-70 no-80.
y-m-18-05.s.s3.hint.2: Ngezinombolo zabafundi owakhethile, zihlolele wena ukuthi isilinganiso sonke siyi-78 ngempela.

y-m-18-05.s.s3.explain: Isibonelo, ngabafundi abangu-5 eKlasi 1 nabangu-20 eKlasi 2, isamba samaphuzu singu-70×5+80×20=1950, futhi ukuhlukanisa ngabafundi abangu-25 kunika u-78 amaphuzu. Uma iKlasi 2 inabafundi abaphindwe izikhathi ezi-4 kuneKlasi 1, isilinganiso sonke singu-78 amaphuzu.

y-m-18-05.s.s3.because.hint.0: Qhathanisa ukuthi amaphuzu angu-75 no-78 asondele kumaphuzu eliphi iklasi.

y-m-18-05.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale ukuthi iklasi elinabafundi abaningi linomthelela omkhulu esilinganisweni sonke?
y-m-18-05.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe isiqondiso sokuya ngaphezulu kuno-75 amaphuzu nesizathu kuyahambisana?
y-m-18-05.s.s3.because.model.0: IKlasi 2 inabafundi abaphindwe izikhathi ezi-4 kuneKlasi 1, ngakho isilinganiso sisondela kumaphuzu eKlasi 2 angu-80. Yingakho kungu-78 amaphuzu hhayi u-75 amaphuzu.

y-m-18-06.title: Ake senze i-spinner engakhethi muntu
y-m-18-06.goal: Hlulele ukuthi amathuba afana ngenani lezingxenye, yenza ama-spinner amaningana ahlangabezana nemibandela, bese usho ukuthi ‘ukulingana’ no-‘kangaki kunomnqobi’ kuyizindaba ezihlukene.
y-m-18-06.material: UHaeun noDoyun badlala umdlalo we-spinner. I-spinner ihlukaniswe ngokulinganayo ibe izingxenye ezingu-12 zosayizi ofanayo, futhi umcibisholo kungenzeka ngokulinganayo ukuthi umise kunoma iyiphi ingxenye. Ingxenye ngayinye ibhalwe elinye lawo ‘Haeun,’ ‘Doyun,’ noma ‘ungenalutho.’ Umuntu ogama lakhe lisengxenyeni lapho umcibisholo umisa khona uthola iphuzu eli-1, futhi uma kungu-‘ungenalutho,’ akekho othola iphuzu. ‘Ngokulinganayo’ kusho ukuthi abantu ababili banethuba elifanayo lokuthola iphuzu.
y-m-18-06.s.s1.prompt: Khetha wonke ama-spinner alinganayo kulawa alandelayo. (Wonke anezingxenye ezingu-12.)
y-m-18-06.s.s1.hint.0: Kuma-spinner ngamunye, bhala eceleni komunye amathuba kaHaeun nawo kaDoyun okuthola iphuzu njengenani lezingxenye kwezingu-12.

y-m-18-06.s.s1.o.a: UHaeun izingxenye ezingu-6, uDoyun izingxenye ezingu-3, ezingenalutho izingxenye ezingu-3
y-m-18-06.s.s1.r.a: Inani lezingxenye zomuntu oyedwa liphindwe kabili kwelomunye. Bheka ukuthi inani lezingxenye linquma kanjani usayizi wethuba.
y-m-18-06.s.s1.o.b: UHaeun izingxenye ezingu-5, uDoyun izingxenye ezingu-5, ezingenalutho izingxenye ezingu-2
y-m-18-06.s.s1.r.b: Wahlulele ukulingana ngokuqhathanisa izinombolo zezingxenye zabantu ababili, hhayi inani lezingxenye ezingenalutho.
y-m-18-06.s.s1.o.c: UHaeun izingxenye ezingu-5, uDoyun izingxenye ezingu-4, ezingenalutho izingxenye ezingu-3
y-m-18-06.s.s1.r.c: Izingxenye ezingu-5 nezingu-4 zibukeka zifana, kodwa amathuba awafani.
y-m-18-06.s.s1.o.d: UHaeun izigaba ezingu-4, uDoyun izigaba ezingu-4, ongenalutho izigaba ezingu-4
y-m-18-06.s.s1.r.d: Noma kunezigaba eziningi ezingenalutho, kunobulungisa uma amanani ezigaba zabantu ababili efana.
y-m-18-06.s.s1.explain: Ukuze kube nobulungisa, uHaeun noDoyun kumele babe nenani elifanayo lezigaba. Ukuthi zingaki izigaba ezingenalutho akunakho ukuhlobana nobulungisa. NgoHaeun izigaba ezingu-6 noDoyun izigaba ezingu-3, ithuba likaHaeun lokuthola iphuzu (1/2) liphindwe kabili lelikaDoyun (1/4), futhi ngezigaba ezingu-5 nezingu-4 lihluka njengo-5/12 no-4/12.
y-m-18-06.s.s2.prompt: Wenza i-spinner entsha yezigaba ezingu-12. Yenza ama-spinner angu-2 ahlukile anobulungisa (inani lezigaba zikaHaeun u-h nenani lezigaba zikaDoyun u-d alingana) futhi lapho ithuba lika-‘ongenalutho’ lingu-1/6 kuya ku-1/2. (Inani lezigaba ezingenalutho ngu-k. U-h, d, no-k yizinombolo zemvelo futhi zingeza zibe izigaba ezingu-12.)

y-m-18-06.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi zingaki izigaba kwezingu-12 ezenza ithuba elingu-1/6 lokungenalutho nokuthi zingaki ezenza u-1/2, futhi ulungise ububanzi.

y-m-18-01.title: Amaqembu amabili anesilinganiso esifanayo: ingabe amarekhodi awo nawo afana?
y-m-18-01.goal: Khombisa ngezibonelo zezinombolo oziyenzele ukuthi amarekhodi ngamunye angahluka kakhulu noma isilinganiso sifana, bese usho ukuthi yini engenakwaziwa ngesilinganiso sodwa.
y-m-18-01.material:

y-m-18-02.title: Uma ujikijela izinhlamvu zemali ezimbili, iyiphi imiphumela ephuma kaningi?
y-m-18-02.goal: Qhathanisa izincazelo ezimbili (yonke imiphumela emithathu iyafana / bheka izinhlamvu ngokwehlukana wehlukanise amacala) nedatha yokuhlola, buyekeza isinqumo sakho, bese usho ukuthi kungani sihlukanisa amacala.
y-m-18-02.material:
Ujikijela inhlamvu ebomvu nenhlamvu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ngesikhathi esisodwa. Inhlamvu ngayinye inethuba elifanayo lekhanda nomsila, futhi inhlamvu eyodwa ayithinti enye.
UJia: “Kunemiphumela emithathu: [yomibili ikhanda], [elinye ikhanda elinye umsila], no-[yomibili umsila], ngakho zonke zinethuba elifanayo.”
UMinho: “Kunezinhlamvu ezimbili, ngakho kufanele sibheke ukuthi inhlamvu ngayinye iphuma kanjani ngokwehlukana.”
